sentences.cn_source: 难民工作者称这种行为违背了医学道德。

trans.cn: Đạo đức, đạo đức; đạo đức; có lợi cho con người, thân thiện với môi trường; (thuốc) bán theo toa
trans.cn_source: 道德的，伦理的；合乎道德的；有益于人（类）的，环保的；（药品）凭处方出售的

sentences.c: The president has a blind spot on ethical issues.
sentences.cn_source: 这位总统似乎看不到伦理问题的重要性。

sentences.c: The trade association promotes ethical business practices.
sentences.cn_source: 这个贸易协会提倡合乎道德标准的商业行为。

sentences.c: These shoppers are concerned with some ethical issues.
sentences.cn_source: 这些购物者也关心一些道德问题。

trans.cn: Tấn công; khó chịu; tội phạm; trái ngược với (thông thường) (phân từ hiện tại của hành vi phạm tội)
trans.cn_source: 冒犯；令人不适；犯罪；违反（常规）（offend 的现在分词）

trans.cn: Khó chịu; bất hợp pháp
trans.cn_source: 令人不快的；违法的

sentences.c: Allen back-pedalled, saying that he had had no intention of offending them.
sentences.cn_source: 爱伦改变了立场，表示他没有冒犯他们的意思。

sentences.c: They want to avoid offending any of their audience.
sentences.cn_source: 他们想避免冒犯任何观众。

sentences.c: He started offending at the age of 16.
sentences.cn_source: 他16岁就开始犯法。

trans.cn: hãy cẩn thận, coi chừng
trans.cn_source: 当心，提防

sentences.c: Motorists have been warned to beware of icy roads.
sentences.cn_source: 已经提醒开车的人当心冰封的路面。

sentences.c: Motorists were warned to beware of slippery conditions.
sentences.cn_source: 汽车驾驶者被提醒小心路滑。

sentences.c: I think the moral of the story is let the buyer beware.
sentences.cn_source: 我想这个故事的寓意是提醒购买者当心。

trans.cn: người tiêu dùng, khách hàng, người sử dụng; người ăn, người sử dụng, người tiêu dùng
trans.cn_source: 消费者，顾客，用户；食用者，使用者，消耗者

sentences.c: We are living in a consumer culture.
sentences.cn_source: 我们生活在一种消费文化之中。

sentences.c: Firms have to be responsive to consumer demand.
sentences.cn_source: 公司必须对顾客的需求作出积极反应。

sentences.c: Record oil prices have dented consumer confidence.
sentences.cn_source: 前所未有的高油价已经挫伤消费者信心。

trans.cn: đáng tin cậy, đáng tin cậy
trans.cn_source: 值得信赖的，可信的

sentences.c: He is a trustworthy and level-headed leader.
sentences.cn_source: 他是个可信赖的、头脑冷静的领导。

sentences.c: This occurs because they're perceived to be fair and trustworthy.
sentences.cn_source: 之所以出现这种情况，是因为他们被认为是公平的、值得信赖的。

sentences.c: I used to think Emily was honest and trustworthy, but now I know better.
sentences.cn_source: 我曾经认为艾米丽是诚实和值得信赖的，但现在我更清楚了。
